  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 2:04 p.m., Chair Sarah Bedy called the meeting to order.

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lewis, Lie

Also present: Stephanie Sosa, Community Program Specialist, Jennifer Santana, Secretary,
Paul Duncan, Homeless Services Bureau Manager.

  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None

   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, NOVEMBER 18, 2024
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

  Absent:  1 Chotiswatdi

  • Bureau manager Paul Duncan provides updates on the movement of
  individuals in parks and those being relocated to shelters, including the
  Vagabond. The city is actively addressing concerns related to Jenny Rivera
  Memorial Park.
  • HSB staff are awaiting updates on funding for the LA Riverbed Round 3, with
  news expected within the next month.
  • Committee members and city staff discuss Jenny Rivera Park, and the
  tracking and monitoring of tickets issued to unhoused individuals.

3.  24-55613  Recommendation to discuss the Clean Sweeps Public Works
  presentation, presented at the Homeless Services Advisory Committee Meeting on
  September 04, 2024.

  • Subcommittee members explore options for expanding shower facilities and
  consider the possibility of offering 24/7 restroom access at City Hall.
  • Staff provided details about the youth center, which will offer 80 storage units
  and is anticipated to open next year.
  • Staff shared questions and answers exchanged via email with Jose Bedolla
  from Public Works concerning the costs associated with each encampment
  and the budget allocated for cleanups.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Bedy, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Killion, Lewis, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Chotiswatdi

4.  24-55614  Recommendation to discuss the potential visit to 1955 Long Beach Boulevard to
  gain further insight into the services offered at MHALA’s Integrated Service Center.

  • Chair Sarah Bedy provided an update on the last conversation with staff from
  Councilwoman Saro’s office regarding a walk through, staff advised they
  would need to reach out directly to schedule this.
  • Bureau Manager Paul Duncan informed the subcommittee that the city no
  longer has a contract with MHALA and are no longer being funded as a
  service provider.
